title: Move threads kept without a host into the host when one appears
body:
Part of #10003.

Threads made by `openagents chat` without a host live in `~/.openagents/chat/threads/`, with their own device key. When the desktop app or a host later runs on the same computer, those threads should join the host's store, so the desktop (and, via the phone-read issue, the phone) shows them.

Migrate once, idempotently, keeping thread IDs, turns, times, router metadata and Coder links. Re-encrypt under the host's store. Leave a marker so the in-process store isn't read again. Never lose a thread if migration fails halfway.

**Acceptance:** threads created without a host appear in `openagents chat threads` via the host, and in the desktop list, after the host starts. Migration twice is a no-op.
